evidence_collection_requirements_if_nfl.note: One NFL season of game-days is unlikely to meet the 70-date floor; multi-season collection or an explicit NFL date-block redesign would be required. That does not block starting capture and mapping tests.

selection.no_expansion_would_be_correct_if: NFL books are systematically missing/ineligible on the provisional US venue, or the owner confirms a different venue that does not list NFL moneylines.
selection.rationale: NFL is the only candidate with both documented Polymarket US league events and an existing in-repo schedule/prediction identity (game_id). Selection is for research infrastructure reuse and immediate public-data capture — not because any backtest showed profit. NBA/NHL remain uncertain pending sport adapters; they may later beat NFL on date density.
